capabilities: Sync events two-way with CalDAV or iCloud servers
Store events in per-month Markdown notes with user prose preserved
Show events in List, Day, Week, Month and Stats views
Edit events with categories, status, location, attendees, recurrence and reminders
Create events by drag and drop on day/week time grids or natural-language quick add
extras: Desktop and mobile; requires Obsidian 1.7.2+. Credentials are stored locally in Obsidian settings and sent only to the configured server. Optional in-Obsidian reminder notifications poll every 30 seconds while Obsidian is open; sync-on-startup and reminders are off by default. Bilingual English/简体中文 UI. Also installable via BRAT (jiang198012/ogenda). README notes duplicate events can appear after import/export due to UID collisions, fixed by deleting blocks and re-syncing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar, so events must be tracked in an outside app and copied into notes by hand.
summary: Calendar/agenda panel that stores events in local Markdown monthly notes and syncs them two-way with CalDAV or iCloud.
